headline: European live updates: Liverpool held by Forest, big-spending Spurs stumble vs. Newcastle
description: Soccer matches are kicking off in the Premier League and across Europe with all five of the continent's major leagues finally in action!

headline: Nottingham Forest nearing deal for Daniel Muñoz from Crystal Palace - sources
description: Nottingham Forest are closing in on the signing of full-back Daniel Muñoz from fellow Premier League side Crystal Palace, sources have told ESPN.

headline: Everton fans threaten 'riot' over potential sale of teenage winger Harrison Armstrong to Nottingham Forest
description: Everton fans threatened to "riot" if the club cash in on teenage winger Harrison Armstrong.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Could Julián Álvarez rejoin Man City?
description: Barcelona and Arsenal target Julián Álvarez is being lined up for a return to Manchester City. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Muñoz rescues draw for a Liverpool team unable to shake last season's bad habits
description: It's a new season for Liverpool, with a new manager, but Andoni Iraola's side are showing the same shortcomings that cost Arne Slot his job last term.

headline: Hull make it two wins in two as Liam Millar scores only goal at Coventry
description: Hull continued their dream start to life in the Premier League as substitute Liam Millar snatched a 1-0 win away to Coventry.
